title: A failed dispatch strands its lane forever - eleven bails registered a store job and never settled it
description: generationStore.register takes a lane slot, and eleven pre-dispatch failure exits in commandExecutor called exec.onError and returned without settling the job. _laneBusy derives from the store's running list, so the lane never freed and _dispatchNextCue skipped it until the app restarted. Fixed structurally via _failBail; live proof still owed.
acceptance: Every failure exit between generationStore.register and the /prompt POST moves the job to a terminal phase
A new bail added to that region cannot reopen the hole without failing a test
Proven LIVE: force one bail, confirm the NEXT generation on that lane dispatches instead of sitting on QUEUED
